A '''second harvester''' was owned by the [[Gozzo]] businessman [[Raxlo]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. After the [[Raxlo's harvester|first harvester]] was destroyed, another one was built.<ref name="Helpful Harvester">{{YJA|The Helpful Harvester}}</ref> Raxlo flew the new harvester during the [[Battle of Tenoo]] in support of his [[Jedi]] allies.<ref name="Battle of Tenoo">{{YJA|The Battle of Tenoo}}</ref>

Later, Raxlo was coerced by the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Bulcha]] into selling his second harvester. Bulcha intended to use the second harvester to extract [[tenga rock]]s from the [[wellagrin]] habitat on [[Andraven]]. After the [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi younglings]] [[Kai Brightstar]], [[Lys Solay]] and [[Nubs]] sabotaged Bulcha's harvester, Bulcha seized [[Raxlo's third harvester]] and attempted to continue harvesting tenga rocks. Raxlo managed to repair his second harvester and used it to defeat Bulcha in a brief skirmish. Following Bulcha's defeat, Raxlo reclaimed both his harvesters and proceeded to repair them.<ref name="Harvester Madness">{{YJA|Harvester Madness}}</ref>
